author: GameTrailers
description:
Pompeii: The Legacy will leave early access, and the full release will be available on PC on April 9, 2026. Rebuild Pompeii from the ashes and lead it through centuries of politics, intrigue, and survival. Shape laws, expand trade across the Empire, guide your city through disasters, and command legions in optional real-time battles. Your legacy begins now.

#PompeiiTheLegacy #Gaming #IGN
title: Pompeii: The Legacy - Official Full Release Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Turn-Based Mode Launch Trailer for Pillars of Eternity, the hit fantasy adventure RPG developed by Obsidian Entertainment. Players can now play the game in a whole new way, with turn-based combat being implemented. Switch between the classic Real-Time with Pause system and Turn-Based Mode at any time in Pillars of Eternity, available now for PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, GoG, and Xbox on PC).
title: Pillars of Eternity - Official Turn-Based Mode Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Meet Ekku and see the character in action in this new trailer for Morbid Metal, an upcoming hack-and-slash roguelite set in a dark sci-fi world. In Morbid Metal, switch characters instantly mid-fight to chain abilities into devastating combos and tear through waves of lethal machines. Take risks to gain power and build momentum as you face cinematic, challenging bosses. Death is how you evolve. Break through the simulation. Morbid Metal will be available in Steam Early Access on April 8, 2026.
title: Morbid Metal - Official Ekku Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Game Announcement Trailer for Cheat Death, a card-game deckbuilding roguelite developed by GG Studio. Players will engage in an intense game of dice poker with the Grim Reaper. Stack upgrades, tip the scales in your favor, and thwart the plans of Death itself. Cheat Death is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Cheat Death - Official Game Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the Frostpunk 2: Breach of Trust announcement trailer for this upcoming second DLC for the society survival strategy game. The Breach of Trust DLC for Frostpunk 2 will be available on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, GOG, and Windows PC), Xbox Game Pass, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) on June 23, 2026. 

In Frostpunk 2, develop, expand, and advance your city in a society survival game set 30 years after an apocalyptic blizzard ravaged Earth. You face not only the perils of never-ending winter, but also the powerful factions that watch your every step inside the Council Hall.

#Frostpunk2BreachOfTrust #Frostpunk2 #Gaming
title: Frostpunk 2: Breach of Trust - Official DLC Reveal Trailer | Frostpunk Franchise Fest 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the new episode of the Starfield Animated Anthology, and witness the Terran Armada at the height of their power as they invade the Settled Systems. In 'Ab Astris Ad Terram,' the leaders of the Terran Armada test the limits on how far they are willing to go in their unification effort, including the kidnapping of a brilliant roboticist. Starfield's Terran Armada story DLC will be available on Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, Xbox Cloud, Steam, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) on April 7 alongside the Free Lanes Update.

#Starfield #Gaming #IGN
title: Starfield - Official 'The Settled Systems: Ab Astris Ad Terram Animated Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Art of Driving Trailer for Forza Horizon 6, the latest addition to the racing simulation franchise developed by Playground Games. Players can join the adventure of exploring scenic locations and soaking in the culture of Japan that inspired Forza Horizon 6. Stay tuned for future episodes of the Art of Driving for Forza Horizon 6, launching on May 19 for Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Xbox on PC and Steam), with an eventual release on PlayStation 5 (PS5).

#ForzaHorizon6 #Gaming #IGN
title: Forza Horizon 6 - Official Art of Driving Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Accolades Trailer for MLB The Show 26, the latest addition to the baseball simulation franchise developed by Sony San Diego. Players will embark on a new journey from high school to the Hall of Fame, interact with a variety of different changes and additions, and become an MLB legend through America's favorite pastime. MLB The Show 26 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch.

#MLBTheShow26 #Gaming #IGN
title: MLB The Show 26 - Official Accolades Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Launch Trailer for Nullpoint Protocol, an action roguelike game developed by Everbloom Games. Players will traverse from planet to planet to take on raid-style bosses alone or with friends in co-op. Study enemy attack patterns, attain powerful upgrades, and switch up your build from run to run. Nullpoint Protocol is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Nullpoint Protocol - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Bloodmoored is a first-person psychological horror game where you try to escape an abandoned industrial complex – your father's old factory. Oh, and spoiler alert: you're not alone. But the ghosts you encounter aren't necessarily antagonistic...though you'll need to figure out which ones are and which ones aren't. Wishlist Bloodmoored on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4422660/BLOODMOORED/
title: Bloodmoored - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Xeno Point Gameplay Trailer for PUBG: Battlegrounds, the hit battle royale game developed by PUBG Studio. Players will soon be able to access a PvE roguelite mode set in a sci-fi-themed Mothership to take on an enemy race. Fight, evolve, and rally the squad to victory from run to run. Xeno Point is launching into PUBG: Battlegrounds on April 8 for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) and April 16 on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S.

#PUBG #XenoPoint #Gaming
title: PUBG: Battlegrounds - Official Xeno Point Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a closer look at the story you'll experience as the title character in Samson: A Tyndalston Story, the upcoming gritty, '90s-set, third-person action-adventure-brawler in which you'll need to pay down your debt after a heist gone bad to some very unforgiving people in the very unforgiving city of Tyndalston. Samson: A Tyndalston Story will be released on PC on April 8. 

Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634520/Samson/
title: Samson: A Tyndalston Story – Official Launch Trailer
